niche_preference_profile: This user most consistently prefers interfaces with clear visual hierarchy, generous spacing, rounded card-based layouts, and soft depth. They often favor lighter or muted palettes with cohesive accent colors, subtle gradients, and readable contrast over harsh, overly dark, or visually noisy treatments, though they occasionally respond positively to polished dark/high-tech visuals when they include strong structure and rich presentation. They like screens that feel organized through grouped cards, framed sections, visible navigation, and clear content anchoring. They also prefer straightforward readable typography, refined iconography/illustration, and imagery or previews that are clearly visible rather than dimmed or absent.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers strong, obvious hierarchy with prominent titles or key summaries, clearly grouped sections, anchored content, and layouts that make the main task or information immediately legible.
Prefers open, spacious layouts with generous padding, balanced vertical rhythm, and fewer elements competing at once rather than cramped or overly dense arrangements.
Prefers information organized into unified cards, modular panels, bottom sheets, or clearly framed containers instead of flat, weakly separated, or overly fragmented layouts.
Prefers muted or light color systems with cohesive accent colors, subtle gradients, and balanced contrast rather than generic palettes, harsh saturation, or heavy dark overlays.
Prefers soft visual depth through gentle shadows, layered panels, filled surfaces, blurred backdrops, and larger rounded corners rather than flat, sharp, or rigid treatments.
Prefers straightforward, readable typography with clear emphasis, larger key values, and concise supporting copy over stylized, editorial, all-caps, or weakly differentiated text.

Prefers polished, visible visual elements such as clear preview imagery, album art, consistent icons, simple controls, and supportive illustrations instead of dimmed assets, ambiguous icons, or overly embellished controls.
